 DeMar DeRozan scores 13 points Thursday 
 by Ari Koslow | Nuggets Correspondent | Fri, Oct 23rd 2026, 2:14am EDT 
 DeMar DeRozan scored 13 points (5-9 FG, 0-1 3PT, 3-6 FT) to go along with two rebounds in the Nuggets 96-84 loss against the Thunder. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 DeRozan played 28 minutes off the bench where he also committed five turnovers. Denver will be looking to bounce back as a team on Saturday against the Pelicans.
